title: Residential Electricity Supply Customer Agreement: Early Termination Fee
content:
**ETF-1 (When assessed).** An early termination fee on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is assessed only once the agreement is drop pending or closed, as shown by its status. Only one early termination fee may be billed per agreement; an agreement whose bill lines already carry an early termination fee receives no second one.

**ETF-2 (Termination date).** The termination date is the drop requested date for a customer cancellation, and the close date for a switch-away or a utility move-out.

**ETF-3 (Remaining months).** The months remaining are counted from the termination date to the contract end date as twelve times the difference in years plus the difference in months, plus one when the day of the month of the contract end date is later than the day of the month of the termination date.

**ETF-4 (Amount by method).** Each plan's method, flat fee, fee per remaining month, ceiling and fee-free window are those of the plan's early termination fee schedule. Under the flat method the fee is the flat fee; under the per-remaining-month method it is the fee per remaining month multiplied by the months remaining, limited to the ceiling; under the none method no fee applies.

**ETF-5 (Waivers).** No fee applies when any of the following holds:

- (a) the termination date falls within the plan's fee-free window before the contract end date, counting the contract end date less the termination date in calendar days and treating equality as inside the window;
- (b) the termination date is within the plan's rescission window, in calendar days, after the utility confirmation date;
- (c) the plan waives the fee on a move and the premise carries a utility move-out date on or before the termination date plus 30 calendar days, or the close reason is move out;
- (d) the plan waives the fee for assistance-program customers and the customer is enrolled in a utility customer assistance program (CAP).

When any waiver applies the fee is zero and no line is posted; waivers are not partial and do not stack into a credit.

**ETF-6 (State cap).** Otherwise the fee is finally limited to the state statutory ceiling for the premise's service state when that state has one.

**ETF-7 (No other grounds).** A switch to another supplier is an early termination like any other; a regulatory pass-through, a rate increase on another agreement, or dissatisfaction with the rate do not waive the fee.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)

| Plan and state | Termination date | Contract end | Months remaining | Fee before cap | Fee billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12, PA | 2026-03-05 | 2026-09-20 | 6, plus one because the 20th is later than the 5th: 7 | 7 multiplied by 10.00 is 70.00, under the 120.00 ceiling | 70.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12, IL | 2026-03-05 | 2026-09-20 | 7 | 70.00 | 50.00 after the Illinois cap |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24, OH | 2026-03-25 | 2027-09-20 | 18, no extra month because the 20th is not later than the 25th | 180.00, limited to the 150.00 ceiling | 150.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6, NJ | 2026-05-20 | 2026-06-03 | not needed | 14 days before the end, inside the 14-day window | 0.00, no line |
